next_question.rationale: The largest gap is created->confirmed (lost 87,511, created->confirmed conversion 0.6138). The consultation_trigger cut shows the high-volume 'instant' segment converts much worse (entered 181,651 -> converted 94,141, rate 0.5183) than 'pd_erx_consultation' (entered 44,964 -> converted 44,963, rate 1.0). Scheduling also shows different behavior (walk_in entered 211,023 -> converted 132,511, rate 0.6279; scheduled entered 15,592 -> converted 6,593, rate 0.4228). These patterns are consistent with congestion or timing-related failures (e.g., queuing/system terminations concentrated at peak times). Cut the funnel by hour_of_day to test whether created->confirmed conversion for 'instant' (and overall) drops at specific hours — if so, that would point to capacity/queueing issues to prioritize. A follow-up A/B test could then modify queue handling or availability messaging during peak hours and measure created->confirmed uplift.
